entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 is a universal memory layer for AI agents and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, available as a managed cloud platform or self-hosted open-source software under Apache-2.0. It supports semantic, keyword, and entity-based retrieval, with SDKs, a CLI, and a self-hosted server.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight structures agent memory around retain, recall, and reflect operations for long-term memory workflows. It can be deployed with Docker, pip, or Kubernetes and supports hosted and local LLM providers.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an open-source context database and official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes agent context as browsable files and directories. It supports scoped search and retrieval, with L0, L1, and L2 tiers for loading context.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is an open-source memory platform for agents that structures text as entities, relationships, and searchable chunks. Custom data models and ontologies, along with plugins and MCP, provide ways to shape and connect that memory.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a memory engine and API, and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, that extracts conversation facts and handles contradictions and automatic forgetting. It connects to services including Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub, and processes PDFs, images, videos, and code.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain is an opinionated brain for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent that stores facts with provenance and supports corrections and withdrawal. Memory can be shared across agents while transient task state stays local, with optional semantic search, synthesis, and background enrichment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents that tracks peers, sessions, and messages over time. It supports managed, local, and self-hosted deployments, and includes Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: ByteRover CLI treats memory as a Git repo, managing a plain Markdown context tree with Git-like commit, branch, and merge operations. Its five-tier retrieval includes four non-LLM tiers described as sub-100ms, and it offers an interactive TUI and REPL.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a SQLite-backed memory layer for Hermes agents, described as zero-dependency and sub-millisecond, with one pure-Python dependency. It integrates through MCP, native providers, or a Python SDK; BEAM results are reported for v3.0.0, while LongMemEval is pending.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto extracts and consolidates memories across agents, reconciles conflicting information, and manages forgetting. It also supports memory exchange through the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory OS is a seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that includes vector search and structured facts. It uses local infrastructure with Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite, and a Ground Truth hierarchy to prioritize injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving context harness that runs tasks against evaluation, keeps useful lessons, and discards dead ends. It leaves traces, reports, and playbooks to support agents on complex tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Hermes Agent plugin persists messages in a SQLite store organized as a hierarchical DAG. Its lcm_grep and lcm_recall tools help recover details from past context.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: deja-vu searches session histories across agents and projects, including sessions already on disk. It can also resume a session or continue it in another agent, and runs locally without a model or server.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project lets Hermes Agent use a self-hosted Honcho backend for private memory across sessions. It supports OpenAI-compatible providers and local inference servers, with an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first layer for agent identity, memory, and secrets, with portable state across supported agent harnesses. It connects through hooks, plugins, or extensions and includes a dashboard for browsing memory and asking questions.
entries.plur-ai/plur: plur stores shared agent memory as plain-text YAML engrams and supports local search after a one-time model download, with keyword fallback. Its README reports 95.6% R@5 on LongMemEval-S (N=500).
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device memory and context engine that combines BM25, vector search, rank fusion, and cross-encoder reranking. It can generate session handoffs and capture decisions and preferences, with integrations through hooks, MCP, and native agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory keeps long-term agent memory in a local SQLite file, using FTS5 search and a five-tier schema without a vector database or embeddings. Its package family includes an SDK, CLI, Hermes adapter, MCP server, and LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context ordering for cache-aware scheduling, deduplication, and prefix-cache sharing, including for text and multimodal context. It integrates with Hermes Agent as well as vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, and OpenClaw.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This Hermes memory plugin uses an embedded backend by default, with an HTTP backend also available. Its recall results include a why_retrieved reason, and it supports memory canonicalization and contradiction tracking.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: llm-wiki-cli is an agent-driven CLI for recalling, maintaining, and evolving persistent knowledge across sessions. It builds a source-grounded Wiki with citations and history without requiring embeddings or a vector database.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: agentcairn stores durable, cross-project memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata, using an Obsidian vault as the source of truth. A local DuckDB cache supports hybrid search and retrieval, while MCP servers and host-specific plugins connect it to coding agents.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: flowstate-qmd anticipates context needs by watching agent session logs and prefetching context into a cache. It uses local SQLite-vec storage and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp, and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding-agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack brings Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace together under a single memory owner, with SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma for state and retrieval management. It prepares a purpose-built evidence packet for the agent on each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep combines semantic search with BM25 full-text retrieval and ranked graph traversal, while automatically indexing codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support. Its edge tags connect stored notes through navigable, bidirectional relationships.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Hermes Tool Slimmer reduces tool-schema token overhead through local keyword-based ranking and Tool Search support. It integrates as middleware on Hermes 0.19+ without patching Hermes core, and includes a dashboard for monitoring savings and managing tool configurations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: Agent Context OS provides a Git-backed context and workflow layer for Claude Code, Codex, and other listed agents. Its workflows cover migration, handoffs, and memory proposals, while integrations remain opt-in rather than enabled automatically.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only Hermes plugin stores memory in a single .lbdb embedded graph database file and supports BM25 keyword search with named relationships between entries. Its importance-weighted recall surfaces higher-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: Hermes Local Knowledge indexes configured local sources and selected Hermes runtime sources for capability lookup and routing. It registers five tools for search, retrieval, traversal, feedback, and usage reports, along with three Hermes lifecycle hooks.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Hermes AgentMemory is a pull-model episodic memory plugin with on-demand summarization and a trace.jsonl audit log of prefetch operations. It also supports immediate event deletion, so deleted events are not retained as persistent summaries for future recall.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind: Hermes Blind extracts a session's original goal from its first user turn, with goals, first-sentence, and full extraction modes. It skips tool output and other non-user-turn records, and uses neither a summarizing model nor an external service.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK for x402 payments and an MCP server for budget-bound agent wallets. It operates without a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: The Hermes XMemo plugin runs inside Hermes and communicates with XMemo over HTTPS to provide durable cross-session memory with semantic search. It supplies ranked, bounded context recall before a turn and includes a local SQLite reliability layer.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: The Hermes Exabase plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It provides tools for searching and manually storing memories, with configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: SourceVault Code Tools provides private local code memory for repositories, including semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A. Its slash commands support search, file reads, context, and Q&A across Hermes CLI, Telegram, and Hermes Desktop; it also includes repo sync and indexed git-history search commands.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB-Hermes provides long-term memory for Hermes Agent, with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest enabled by default. It offers dense HNSW, sparse, and FM-index retrieval, and can run through native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield provides Hermes memory tools for managing memories and traversing knowledge graphs. Its hybrid search combines BM25, vector, and graph methods, and it can checkpoint context automatically during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: Agent Memory Kit helps curate agent memory stored in plain Markdown, producing reviewable JSON diffs rather than using a database. Its rot and lint curators flag stale or conflicting facts, while a local Git repository tracks changes and supports reverting them.

entries.obra/superpowers: Superpowers combines composable skills that instruct agents to use them with a software-development workflow spanning specification, design sign-off, planning, and subagent execution. It belongs in this list for its structured approach to guiding agent development work, with installation documented separately for multiple harnesses.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: Open Design is a local-first design and prototyping system with coding-agent CLI support, including Hermes Agent. Its skills, templates, design systems, and plugins support interactive web prototypes with live previews as well as slide decks, images, and motion graphics.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides structured cybersecurity skills across security domains and maps them to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, D3FEND, and F3. It stands out for its security-focused skill library and stated compatibility with more than 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: drawio-skill turns natural-language descriptions and real sources into editable .drawio diagrams. Its incremental sync is designed to preserve manual layout and annotations, and the project also offers the diagramctl CLI and an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: internet-court-skill brings together a master router and connector skills for agent-to-agent commerce, alongside vendored copies of official protocol skills. It also adds a verification and dispute-resolution layer.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: avoid-ai-writing can score files or piped text for detectable AI-writing patterns and offers a rewrite mode with up to two editing passes. Its in-place editing mode refuses to modify source code, configuration, and generated data.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw uses background evolution to automate skill deduplication and quality improvement, while unifying skill libraries across agents, devices, and team members. It lists integrations with Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform skills library includes 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills, with compatibility for Claude Code, Codex, and agent-plug-ins.org specifications. It also maintains session state in the project's docs folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This project offers professional agent skills, each with a framework, output template, and quality checks. Its README describes 1,295 skills and says the project is MIT-licensed.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: youtube-skills covers YouTube transcripts, video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction. It supports Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Cursor, and requires a TranscriptAPI key, which has a stated 100-credit free tier.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: hermes-skill-factory watches active workflows to detect and propose reusable skills, then generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds. Slash commands let users manage, list, and save detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: super-hermes teaches Hermes Agent to generate task-specific analytical instructions and includes pre-built analytical lenses for various domains. It reports findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Adds type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, with progressive disclosure and remote skill registries from Git and S3. It also provides tools for bundled resources and script execution, with sandboxing to isolate untrusted scripts from the host.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Creates .lit.md documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code, then extracts runnable files from them with a tangler. Edits to those source files can also be synced back into the literate document, making this a fit for teams coordinating code and documentation across agents.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: Turns rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents for Hermes Agent. Lite and Full modes suit different levels of project complexity, while a spec review gate evaluates proposals with PASS/FAIL models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro provides a harness for long-running AI agents, with structured memory, cross-feature learning, and a plan-approve-execute approach. It does not require a background service and includes an SLP protocol for supervised teams, along with CLI commands for installation, updates, and diagnostics.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Icarus shares memory across instances through Markdown files and automatically captures high-value decisions and outcomes. It also provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models, connecting accumulated work with model replacement.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This Portuguese-language Hermes Agent community project offers skills in SKILL.md format and guides covering installation, production, cron, MCP, and skill authoring. Contributions are submitted through pull requests, making it a community source of Portuguese-language resources.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Black Forest Labs' skills focus on FLUX image and video generation prompting, with BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. The repository also includes a FLUX 3 video suite with eight specialist skills.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This repository lists nine Chainlink skills, each following the Agent Skills specification, and documents installation with `npx skills add smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills`. Its README describes the repository as containing community examples only.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Skill Forge creates agent instructions from repositories, documentation, and developer discourse. It supports both automated and step-by-step workflows, and includes skill testing and export.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a workflow language for AI that checks workflows before calling a model and runs with a model you choose. It also verifies a tamper-evident record for each run.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock is a registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, with a Python client and CLI. It supports installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: ExecPlan supports autonomous execution of long-running, multi-step tasks, with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. Built-in rollback procedures provide a recovery path when execution needs to be undone.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: Manage Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through WebDAV and CalDAV. It uses HTTPS with Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for validating credentials and configuring access.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Browse, search, and install community skills through a hub implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification. It also offers federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face and operates autonomously via Hermes Agent on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Find relevant skills through five retrieval layers, from hard triggers to semantic embeddings. By narrowing skill lists before LLM calls, it aims to reduce token usage, and it can degrade gracefully when embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: A personal execution OS with agent-driven scheduling and system design through an MCP connection. It stores data locally in a single SQLite file and includes a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: A read-only code review skill that uses parallel subagents to examine edge cases, adversarial concerns, and integration issues, then consolidates and triages findings. It combines deterministic scans with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox to verify findings.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Simplify code with parallel Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness agents for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust. A tiered application process with an approval gate helps control how changes are applied.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: A cybersecurity lab for Hermes Agent that includes 2,077 skills across multiple repositories and installs 131+ tools for network work, forensics, and exploitation. It also integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Adapt verified procedures for multi-story task decomposition, with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. The project also provides an investigation protocol for reproduction and causal debugging, plus a Python goal engine for persistent task state.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C#/.NET implementation of agentskills.io that loads skills progressively from SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading and can automatically register common agent skill directories.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: A local, read-only dashboard for real-time tracking of token costs, session history, and skill analytics. It includes local log desensitization and optional incident alerts through Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: A collection of plain-markdown agent skills for code review, session management, and related workflows, including multi-session reconciliation and worktree recovery. Install skills by copying a directory or using the bundled installer.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: Creates reproducible VHS tape or Playwright recording scripts to add demo GIFs to repository READMEs, supporting terminal CLIs, TUIs, web apps, and libraries. It also optimizes GIFs toward a target size under 8 MB, making it useful for producing lightweight project demos.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: Generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files, then validates them against runtime-specific profiles with CI-friendly exit codes. It also checks official frontmatter specifications weekly for field drift, focusing on keeping skills aligned with changing specs.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: Provides terminal and MCP access to searches across more than 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills, with direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins. Its stated integrations include Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: Analyzes past sessions and indexes installed skills to draft structured improvement proposals. Proposals are review-only by default, with optional auto-application gated by deterministic, LLM-judge, or regression evaluation.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: Provides Hermes Agent skills for routing file operations with environment-specific path syntax and selecting and verifying existing, project-compatible Python interpreters. It supports native Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Packages skills for social data, web research, and enrichment, including combinations of an agent, skills, and a data flow. It also welcomes community contributions in `skills/community/`.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: Offers Hermes skills for transcribing Douyin videos into structured Markdown and SRT subtitles, removing common Chinese AI-writing patterns with a rule-based engine, and extracting structured data from PDFs and images using macOS Vision. The collection also includes an E-commerce Material Studio.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: Lets agents find open support bounties, purchase ticket context, and submit answers for human review; public wallet earnings records are also available. Users can create a bounty board that returns a URL, API key, and USDC deposit addresses.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses and supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Tests agent skills for structure, functionality, and security in isolated Docker containers. It produces Ed25519-signed certificates that can be verified through its public API, which also accepts skill submissions.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: Provides structured web data across 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server exposing 191 tools, along with five ready-to-use workflow skills. It also lists support for Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.parkyucheol-del/alphapipeline: Checks token honeypot, tax, and liquidity risk, and provides market data that includes DEX slippage and funding rates. Its quantitative risk and slippage tools are available through REST endpoints and a remote MCP server.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This Hermes Agent skill generates structured Chinese news briefings at geographic scales from global to street level, with core conclusions and action suggestions. It uses user interests stored in semantic memory to expand searches, making it a fit for agents that need tailored, multi-scale news summaries.
entries.aidatatools-dev/astro-agents-mcp: This project provides an unauthenticated MCP endpoint for deterministic Western and Vedic astrology results, with SHA-256 hashes for verification. Its per-call REST payment options, x402 or MPP, distinguish it as an astrology service designed for agent use.
entries.NickSF189/kisscode-agent: This skill helps AI agents join KissCode and includes SKILL.md and HEARTBEAT.md instructions, plus a registration API example. It offers a focused onboarding capability for agents, and is licensed under MIT.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: Agentic-MCP-Skill is a progressive MCP client that uses three-layer loading to minimize token usage while incrementally discovering server metadata and tool schemas. Its socket-based daemon architecture maintains persistent connections, making it a useful skill for agents that need to work with MCP servers.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project packages AI coding agents and development tools with Nix, including Hermes, and provides a `nix run` command for listed tools. Its packages are updated automatically each day, making it a Nix-based option for running Hermes.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone collects scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent, on Android through Termux. Its highlights include an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android, OpenClaw configuration guides, and hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This Termux-based installer and guide runs Hermes Agent on Android using proot-distro Ubuntu. It supports interactive model setup, gateway services, shell command execution, and external providers or local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart offers direct or operator-ready CRD-based workflows for deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes. It includes single-writer state-safety guardrails for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes AI assistant to Android through Termux and to iOS through iSH. It also integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging, and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: hermesclaw runs Hermes Agent with hardware-enforced sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It restricts network and filesystem access at the kernel level and offers configurable security policies for messaging and web search.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides searchable logs, metrics, alert rules, and access through a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image for Hermes Agent that includes mini-swe-agent and the official Hermes installation. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and lets users build specific Hermes tags with build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This project provides a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployment, with declarative configuration for cli-config.yaml and workspace documents. It supports both Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills, and integrates secrets through systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane for running multiple Hermes Agent instances from one web application, with separate workspaces and identities. It provides per-agent Telegram and WhatsApp channels and granular policies for tools, paths, and network access.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable package that runs from a USB drive or other drive without host installation or registry writes. It includes Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments, and bundles tools for offline use, including Python 3.12, PortableGit, and Sysinternals rescue tools.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It also enables autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.jyje/hermes-agent-helm: This Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with installation available from an OCI registry or a GitHub Pages Helm repository. Optional Copilot and Codex device-login bootstrap and CI testing on an ephemeral kind cluster make it a Kubernetes-focused deployment option.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: TradingAgents is a financial trading framework that assigns trading tasks to agents in specialized roles and has them discuss strategies dynamically. It is designed for research purposes.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hosted system for governing agent tasks, registrations, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It stands out for offering Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, with local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Agent of Empires provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent. It supports persistent tmux sessions, Git worktrees, and multi-repository workspaces, with a web dashboard for structured views, terminal access, and diffs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Hermes Agent Control Room is a template for scaling Hermes Agent from a single VPS agent to specialist teams and automated workflows. Its level-based architecture and task bus support delegation and handoffs, and it includes skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: SwarmClaw is a framework for building autonomous agent swarms, with support for 23+ LLM providers, durable agent memory, and MCP tool integration. Visual org charts provide a way to represent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: Minions is a control interface for creating, supervising, and reviewing autonomous Hermes Agent work. It combines a Kanban board and live streams of agent reasoning and tool execution with human verification of agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. A strict pipeline architecture and Master Orchestrator handle routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Hermes Agent Team is a local web system for coordinating Leader and Specialist agents through an automated task lifecycle. It integrates MCP and ACP for local tools and communication, with a real-time UI for agent dialogues and Kanban task flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Hermes Agent Metaharness automates outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code and orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations. It also provides structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator runs an agent-versus-agent arena in which nine autonomous agents operate across two competing AI companies. Using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, it displays agent tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: HermesAgent-MultiModel is a local Mixture-of-Agents framework that queries models in parallel and synthesizes their outputs, using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It is designed for consumer GPUs, is optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware, and does not require cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Codegraph builds a local project knowledge graph with `codegraph init` and automatically syncs it as files change. Its MCP server connects that pre-indexed graph to Hermes Agent and other coding agents, with the stated goal of reducing token usage and tool calls.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale tracks token consumption across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes, Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, and Gemini. It also provides a dashboard for visualizing usage, making it useful for comparing activity across supported clients.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: Claude Tap is a local trace viewer for coding-agent API traffic, including traffic from Hermes Agent and several other agents. It lets you inspect prompts, tool calls, streaming responses, and token usage, compare adjacent requests, and redact common auth headers before recording traces.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: Token Monitor displays real-time token usage, costs, and rate limits for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and other supported tools. It also offers historical trends and usage breakdowns, with syncing across multiple devices.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build UIs with AI. It works with Hermes Agent and other named assistants, and is compatible with any AI provider that supports markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: Oh My Hermes is an opinionated workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent, installable with `install.sh`. It includes product-development and operations skills, plus a CTO loop made up of seven focused agents.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes Skins customizes the Hermes terminal UI with community-made themes, including changes to banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners. YAML-based configuration supports theme creation, with examples such as retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang statically checks AI-agent configurations, tool descriptions, system prompts, schemas, and other agent-facing files, using HERM v1.1 scoring. It can report findings as JSON, SARIF, or GitLab Code Quality, and findings are advisory by default unless scans are gated on severity.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place describes itself as a social economy for autonomous AI agents. It provides encrypted agent-to-agent messaging using Signal Protocol, identity registration with human-readable @handles, and commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel Browser is an AI-native browser for autonomous agent control via MCP, with support for Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, and other AI providers. Its supervisor sidebar manages agent approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads, and it supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: Hermes-CCC ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to Claude Code Channel, where it runs natively without separate processes or OAuth. It also includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: Cognee Integrations is a monorepo of Cognee-owned integration packages organized into two tiers: a permanent knowledge graph and a session cache. Its Claude Code plugin automatically captures and recalls context.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup combines RTK and Caveman templating for CLI workflows, with the project reporting 90–99% token savings. It also includes 40+ preconfigured skills for finance, DevOps, and research, plus automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents with per-folder configuration and skills. It supports switching between the default agent and scoped agents, with project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: evey-setup automates installation of hermes-agent and 12+ supporting services, with three deployment tiers ranging from a minimum viable setup to a production stack. It also supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This tool migrates OpenClaw data to Hermes, including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives. It also maps configurations and credentials to Hermes YAML and JSON formats and can set up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: observeco is a Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry from agent conversations and monitors multi-agent systems. Its monitoring options include passive analysis and scheduled active probing, while config-aware baselines track performance drift against local file changes.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: hermes-voice adds voice interaction to Hermes Agent, with wake-word activation and support for 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro. It runs offline without API keys or accounts and includes adaptive turn-taking and barge-in.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: hermes-startup provides a local runtime that operates with zero network access by default. It requires explicit approval for consequential actions and external writes, and includes contracts for opportunities, offer previews, and exact approvals.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: hermes-memoss is a memory plugin that supports semantic search and multi-dimensional memory storage. It provides tools to search, add, and delete memories, with a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: CC Switch is a cross-platform manager for Hermes Agent and several other agent tools, including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and Gemini CLI. It lets users switch API providers in one click and manage MCP, Skills, and Prompts in one place.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source cowork app for Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs, with a built-in agent that does not require a separate CLI installation. It includes 21 professional assistants and supports macOS, Windows, and Linux.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI lets users access Hermes Agent from a web browser or phone, using the existing Hermes agent and models. Its three-panel layout brings chat, sessions, and file browsing together.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: Hermes Desktop is a desktop companion for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent, using the official Hermes install script. Its GUI manages profiles, sessions, skills, and tools, and the app is available from the project website or GitHub Releases.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko Studio is a Hermes Agent web dashboard for multi-platform AI chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics, and channel configuration. It also supports shared and group chats, visual workflows, persistent sessions, and tools for files, voice, devices, and agent management; it is available as a desktop app, npm package, and Docker image.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: Hermes Workspace is a web workspace that combines chat with a terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It also offers Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, plus a file browser with Monaco and a PTY terminal.
entries.spacering-net/codeg: CodeG is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents, including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, as a desktop or self-hosted app. Users can import, search, resume, and hand off sessions, delegate across agents, or queue to-dos in worktrees.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace connects directly to Hermes hosts locally or over SSH and provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs. Its embedded terminal gives users direct shell access for system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Hermes-CN-Desktop is a Windows-first Chinese desktop app for Hermes Agent, with support for Windows and macOS and native window and process management. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health checks and updates, along with chat, memory management, and LaTeX and Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to a local, Hermes Cloud, or self-hosted remote Hermes Agent runtime. Bot Mode supports agent switching and group chats, while Hermes Control is opt-in and Chromium-only.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app for driving a self-hosted Hermes Agent, pairing with a hermes-webui server. It is a client-only app for iOS 18 and later; users run the server, and the app is free with no analytics or tracking.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop AI agent workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, plus custom LLM model routing. Its runtime dashboard tracks token usage and latency, while a live workspace shows code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes for monitoring agent growth, Git projects, and scheduled cron jobs. Its tmux operator view also lets users manage live agent panes, making it a fit for terminal-based Hermes workspaces.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: This native macOS app browses and analyzes sessions from Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs, with search across prompts, responses, tool activity, errors, and file paths. It can resume supported sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp, and keeps session history on the Mac without telemetry.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: Hermes Control Interface is a self-hosted web dashboard for the Hermes AI agent stack, bringing together a browser-based terminal, file explorer, session overview, cron management, system metrics, and agent status. It also offers streaming chat with tool-call visualization, MCP server lifecycle controls, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace runs Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts, with one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers. It also includes WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Hermes Agent Mission Control is a self-hostable dashboard template that connects a local Hermes agent to web dashboards through a Postgres message bus. Its approval inbox handles requests with side effects, making it a fit for workflows that need a review step.
entries.liftaris/herm: Herm is an alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard, built with OpenTUI, for chatting and managing agent sessions. It pairs those controls with a kanban board for agentic work and task management, plus management for profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This locally run React SPA provides a 10-page, mobile-first dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0. Its features include streaming terminal chat with file attachments, Telegram validation using HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519, and background spawning for up to five concurrent agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: Portable Hermes Agent is a Windows desktop version that runs without installation, Docker, or admin rights and includes 100 tools across more than 20 toolsets. It supports cloud AI and local models through LM Studio, with a workflow engine for scheduling, conditions, loops, and parallel execution.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: Hermes UI is a self-hosted AI assistant interface with a glassmorphic design, chat, and real-time log streaming. It also combines a file browser and task tracking dashboard with tools for managing skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI is a monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes, with real-time session activity and cost tracking. Users can inspect conversation histories and skill source code, while configuration and environment variables are available in read-only form.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: Pan UI is a self-hosted AI workspace centered on chat, with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It also includes a marketplace for discovering and installing skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profiles for separate sessions, memory, and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: Hermes Agent Desktop is a native desktop client for multi-agent work, with streaming SSE responses and model switching. It supports collaboration among 20 specialized AI agents and includes a visual Skill Store with more than 50 curated one-click installations.
entries.robbyczgw-cla/hermes-ui-plus: An unofficial, open-source interactive chat client for a self-hosted Hermes Agent, with answers that can include checklists, choices, forms, and rankings. It also lets you approve or deny commands from your phone and runs on Android, web, and macOS, with Linux in alpha.
